scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc && node scripts/build-worker-inline.mjs && bash scripts/copy-runtime-assets.sh
scripts.build:dev: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc && node scripts/build-worker-module.mjs && bash scripts/copy-runtime-assets.sh --include-wasm
scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:sherpa-wasm && npm run build:llama-wasm
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/llm-next/operations.test.mjs tests/llm-next/worker.test.mjs tests/tts-next/*.test.mjs tests/stt-next/*.test.mjs tests/vad-next/*.test.mjs && node src/assets/tests/run.mjs
scripts.test:types: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck tests/llm-next/inference.ts ../../tests/schema/parent-types.test.ts tests/stt-next/inference.ts tests/vad-next/inference.ts
